raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Endpoint membership of the supported half-edges",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The upper half of the left edge, left half of the bottom edge, and bottom-right corner are marked as supported. Whether each half-edge node set includes its corner and midpoint endpoints is unspecified.",
      "readings": [
        "Fix all nodes on the two closed half-edges, including their endpoints, plus the bottom-right corner.",
        "Fix only nodes strictly between the corner and midpoint of each marked half-edge, plus the bottom-right corner."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4.1 describes node sets 'between corners and midpoints'; Fig. 5, row 1 shows green support segments without identifying individual endpoint nodes."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Loaded element on the left boundary",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The red arrow indicates a load near the lower portion of the left edge, but its exact boundary-element index is not supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "Select left-boundary element row 13, indexed from zero at the bottom, with centre height y/H = 13.5/64.",
        "Select left-boundary element row 14, indexed from zero at the bottom, with centre height y/H = 14.5/64."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4.1 specifies random selection of a boundary element; Fig. 5, row 1 supplies only an arrow without coordinates or an element index."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial application of the unit boundary load",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Selecting a boundary element does not specify whether the force is concentrated at a node or distributed along that element's boundary edge.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply the unit resultant as a concentrated force at one boundary node of the selected element.",
        "Apply uniform traction over the selected element's boundary edge, with unit resultant, giving equal forces at its two edge nodes."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4.1 specifies a unit load sampled from a boundary element; Eq. (24) uses element-associated force components but does not define their assembly into the nodal force vector of Eq. (1). Fig. 5, row 1 does not show load extent."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional elastic constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The elastic modulus and Poisson's ratio are provided, but the plane-stress or plane-strain assumption is not stated.",
      "readings": [
        "Use plane stress with E = 1 and Poisson's ratio 0.3.",
        "Use plane strain with E = 1 and Poisson's ratio 0.3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4.1 specifies a two-dimensional square-element domain, unit elastic modulus, and Poisson's ratio 0.3; neither it nor Sec. 2.1 specifies plane stress or plane strain."
    }
  ]
}
